main_body: A bonsai-style pine tree: a leaning brown trunk with three green foliage pads (upper canopy, right branch pad, left branch pad)
top_band: Foliage pads show lighter green top surfaces (rows ~1-8 on upper canopy) above darker green undersides; the trunk is a vertical organic form. Organic canopy shows a lit top and a shaded underside.
evidence: Organic tree, not a rigid architectural object. Canopy pads have lighter tops and darker shaded undersides with dark-green outlines, reading as volumes seen from above at an angle. The trunk is a leaning column with highlight and shadow sides. No receding side faces and no flat elevation. Pads are lumpy clusters with a lit top and shadowed bottom, which fits the organic kind.

style.evidence: Canopy uses about 5 green steps with clumpy light/dark pixel groups, and a dark green outline that follows the leaf tone. The trunk uses brown highlight, mid, and dark steps, with a dark brown outline and a small grass tuft at the base. Compared with the references, the leaf clumps are larger and smoother and the trunk is less textured, with fewer per-leaf highlight dots, so it is a little thinner. It still has no flat fills of 5x5 or more and no sticker-like black outline, so it would sit acceptably beside the references.
